acknowledgments.title: Acknowledgments
paragraphs: I am writing to express my deepest gratitude to all of you for your unwavering support and prayers throughout my journey.
First and foremost, I give all thanks to God, for His guidance and grace, because without Him, I would not be here today. God is my foundation.

To my husband, Pastor Juan Damon, and our beautiful daughters, Qianna and Tianna: thank you for your constant encouragement and for believing in me, even during moments of self-doubt. Your love is my greatest strength.

To the wonderful women who dedicated themselves to praying with me... and for me for countless years, during our 6 AM EST daily prayer sessions, regardless of the time zone I was in - Alzie Ross, Donald Ruffin, Loretta Napier, Yvette Picard, Carla Lane, and Juanita Powers: your devotion and spiritual partnership have been absolutely invaluable.

Additionally, to my siblings, Julieth Robinson and Henry Ross, and my dear sister-friend who walked closely alongside me during my most challenging times, Meredith Shepard: I am profoundly grateful for your presence, strength, and constancy in my life.
And to Johnathan for the countless nights editing and formatting, for making this dream into reality, I don't have the words.
Thank you all from the bottom of my heart for standing by me.
